beaches.name: Playa de Maspalomas
beaches.summary: Nudism has a designated zone at La Punta / Cañada de la Penca, Maspalomas beach. The municipal beach catalogue states the beach has a space for practising nudism in that zone; the Cabildo's tourism site says three kilometres of dunes separate the nudist zone from the rest of the beach.

beaches.name: Playa del Inglés
beaches.summary: Playa del Inglés has a delimited nudist zone. The San Bartolomé de Tirajana municipal beach catalogue (dated 2016) states the beach has a well-delimited area as a nudist zone but does not say where it is; the Cabildo's tourism site places the nudist zone in the dunes between the Maspalomas lighthouse and Playa del Inglés.
